arguments.summary: Edwin Park, the executive director, met with a program coordinator for a program check-in. The youth workshop moved to January after the facilitator cancelled, and the new outline is due this Friday. The facilitator cheque is pending with Carla in finance.

sections.heading: Updates
points: Cancelling the Tuesday drop-in, decided last week, is done.

sections.heading: Challenges and blockers
points: The youth workshop is behind because the facilitator cancelled.

sections.heading: Feedback
points: Edwin said the coordinator is doing really well in the new role and should keep it up.

sections.heading: Goals and development
points: The youth workshop moves to January so it is not rushed.

arguments.text: Move the youth workshop to January.

arguments.evidence: As ED I'd rather we move it than rush it.

arguments.text: Ask Carla in finance to cut the cheque for the January facilitator
Okay, decided: we move the youth workshop to January.
I'll finish the new workshop outline by this Friday.
